paragraphs.text: Itzquinth is a legendary dinosaur from Ixalan .

Itzquinth is a character that debuted in The Lost Caverns of Ixalan . They are the firstborn child of Gishath , though unlike their father, they are not an avatar. It appears as a blue-green small raptor with red hair along its spine. While dinosaurs have no concept of royalty, they do recognize the scent of the strongest among them, like Gishath, leading them to honor or avoid it even if it's still young.
